title: Descent of a fixed-base cohomology class at an inverse limit
statement: Let S be a scheme, F an abelian etale sheaf on S, I a small cofiltered category, and D:I→Over(S) a diagram whose underlying schemes are quasi-compact and quasi-separated and whose transition morphisms are affine. Let c be a cone and suppose its underlying scheme cone is limiting. For every q≥0 and every x in H^q(c.pt.left,c.pt.hom inverse image F), there are i in I and y in H^q(D_i.left,D_i.hom inverse image F) such that pullback of y along c_i equals H^q of the forward inverse-image composition comparison applied to x. There is no assertion about a class vanishing eventually.

source.place: Theorem 59.51.3, Tag 09YQ; Tag 0032 for directed reindexing

proof.text: Replace I opposite by a final small nonempty directed preorder using directed reindexing. Initiality of its opposite preserves the underlying limit cone; the geometric hypotheses restrict to the reindexed diagram.

Use the inverse upperStarComp comparisons for the sheaves pulled back from F, and the forward comparisons on the limit. CompatiblePullbackSheafSystem gives their identity, composition and cone equations. The limit sheaf diagram is constant and has its identity colimit cocone.
Construct the canonical cohomology functor and comparison cocone with EtaleLimitCanonicalCohomologyDiagram. Apply continuity for the directed inverse limit with this constant sheaf colimit.

Filtered colimits of abelian groups are preserved by the forgetful functor. Represent the limit class at a stage using Concrete.isColimit_exists_rep. Evaluate the specified cocone comparison equation on the representative and cancel H of the inverse composition isomorphism against H of its forward isomorphism. This gives precisely the displayed pullback equation, with no assertion about eventual vanishing.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YQ via compatible pullbacks and canonical cohomology diagrams; W2 stage-3 proof. Explicit kernel-checked congruences transport the compatibility equations. The reindexed diagram has explicit objects and arrows, its cone has explicit projections, and the kernel checks the final definitional conversion after evaluating H.

theorem exists_cohomologyMap_preimage_of_isLimit {S : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I]
    [IsCofiltered I] (D : I ⥤ Over S) [∀ i, CompactSpace (D.obj i).left]
    [∀ i, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i).left] [∀ {i j} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g).left]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c)) (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ x : Sheaf.H ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} c.pt.hom).obj F) q,
      ∃ (i : I) (y : Sheaf.H ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.obj i).hom).obj F) q),
        Etale.cohomologyMap (c.π.app i).left _ q y =
          Sheaf.H.map ((Etale.upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app i).left (D.obj i).hom
            c.pt.hom (Over.w (c.π.app i)).symm).hom.app F) q x
